issues.description: The parameter order of PersonService.addParent is inconsistent: the problem statement and the template declare the method as addParent(Person person, Person parent) (person first, parent second), but the solution implementation declares it as addParent(Person parent, Person person) (parameters reversed). This mismatch changes the expected positional meaning of the two Person arguments and will confuse students when calling or implementing the method (and may lead to incorrect parent/child relationships).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's method signature match the problem statement and template: declare addParent(Person person, Person parent) (person first, parent second) and update the implementation parameter usages accordingly (check person.getParents().size() and add parent to person's parents). Alternatively, if the intended order is the reversed one, update the problem statement, template, and tests to consistently use that order. Maintain consistent parameter ordering across problem, template, tests, and solution.
